title: Maximum floor area ratios for a residential building or the residential portion of a mixed building
previewText: For residential buildings or residential portions of mixed buildings in the Special Midtown District, the underlying floor area regulations shall apply except that in the C5-P District, the maximum residential floor area ratio shall be 8.0 for zoning lots containing standard residences, and 9.6 for zoning lots containing qualifying affordable housing or qualifying senior housing.
